scientific_question: Is the negative endpoint/JVP recovery specific to seven-trunk compression, or is it the ordinary disagreement between independently optimized dense full-attention endpoints with a matched validation-loss separation?

frozen_comparison.compact_specific_endpoint_restriction: dense-dense output mean recovery exceeds compact output mean recovery by at least 0.10
frozen_comparison.compact_specific_jacobian_restriction: output margin is below 0.10 but dense-dense JVP mean recovery exceeds compact JVP mean recovery by at least 0.10
frozen_comparison.cross_run_nonidentifiability: both dense-dense recovery improvements are below 0.10
frozen_comparison.mixed: report both margins explicitly if both exceed 0.10; endpoint remains the primary branch because classification is ordered output before JVP

authorization.allowed: one zero-update dense-dense calibration using the exact checkpoints and fixed batch above
not_allowed: using the uncalibrated endpoint result as evidence for a new representation
